## About
Cho's Auto Body Shop started with Kyu Bo Cho. He drove buses and studied engineering in Seoul, South Korea, then moved to the United States to build a better life for his family. He worked as a mechanic for shops around Houston until he saved enough to buy land off Boone Road and open a place of his own.
Today his sons Young and Steve manage the shop. Young has been working here since middle school and is our General Manager. Steve came on after a career as a chemical engineer. We handle body, mechanical and paint work on passenger vehicles of all types and some commercial vehicles.
You're never just one job to us. We want to be the shop you rely on for good work at an honest price, and the one you mention when a friend asks if you know a good mechanic. Our customers rate us 4.9 from 348 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: From a simple fender bender to bigger damage, including bumper repair and complete repainting.
- Auto body repair: Body work, welding and repainting, from minor dents and dings to major damage.
- Frame repair and replacement: We straighten or replace damaged frames.
- Paintless dent repair: Small dents and dings pulled out without repainting.
- Auto air conditioning repair: We check the system top to bottom, fix leaks, replace worn parts and recharge it so it blows cold again.
- Transmission repair: Diagnostics, rebuilds, replacements and clutch work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance?
A: We accept all types of insurance and are preferred vendors for Nationwide and Progressive. You can also ask your insurer to have the repairs done here. If you're not sure, give us a call.

Q: Are estimates free, and is the work covered?
A: Yes. Estimates are free, and our repairs come with a lifetime warranty. We're happy to walk you through it when you pick up your car.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Passenger vehicles of all types, plus some commercial vehicles.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're on Boone Road, between Bellaire Blvd and Beechnut St, just west of the Sam Houston Tollway.
